title: Recommend a good single use, single image to 3D
author: Unlikely-Aardvark725
selftext:
As the title states.

Can anyone recommend a single image to 3d tool?

I have tried the "free" ones that range from piss poor to pretty good. But to download the 3D model I must subscribe to the app...

I don't mind paying for a one off or a months use...but not a rolling contract at $25 a month for a year when I only want on thing doing 😂.

It's SFW btw. Not that it should matter.

comments.author: OfficeMagic1
comments.body: If you have a 3050 or higher you can install Hunyan 3d using Pinokio.

comments.author: SeesawGullible398
comments.body: I made [https://img-to-3d.com/](https://img-to-3d.com/) which uses the latest ml models from Microsoft, and it works better then I had expected imo. You can get one generation for just 0.75$ or 0.5$ if you do 10. I think this pricing is fair, since i can barely cover the server costs with that.

comments.author: hikari-desu
comments.body: For single-image workflows, you might want to check out Hitem3D. The recent 2.0 update added high-res textures, which really nail the photorealistic look rather than just getting the geometry right. It definitely helps if you need the surface details to match the original input quality without that washed-out look.
